provenance: Synthetic frozen contrasts for future Qwen voice and D3 choice review. No model output, world event, or gameplay effect is represented as real.

nativeFixtureAnchor.identityProvenance: Reuses person ID and save name from MoodEvaluation fixture only. Every event, time, trait value, relationship value, witness, obligation, option and outcome below is synthetic.

pairContract.mergeRule: Deep-merge each arm.contextPatch into pair.commonInput. Each pair changes one named factor only; all other supplied input stays byte-for-byte equivalent after merge.

roles.qwen: Generate grounded NPC voice from supplied facts and voice profile. Evaluate meaning, tone, uncertainty, and unsupported claims by human review; do not require exact wording.
roles.d3: Select one supplied option ID from the native-eligible set. Never add options or directly execute effects.

pairContract.semantics: expectedNativeEligibleOptionIds describes native-authorized choices for the synthetic contract. acceptableD3Choices is a broad semantic choice set, not one exact answer. Neither field claims current runtime support.
pairContract.evidenceModel: nativeFacts describe world truth; npcKnowledge describes what this NPC has observed, been told, or can infer. Unknown is explicit. Do not grant appraisal access to hidden facts.
pairContract.noRerolls: Freeze corpus and model outputs. Do not retry failed or undesirable outputs, reroll prompts, or edit this corpus after seeing model responses. Create separately versioned held-out paraphrases.

pairs.factorRationale: Trust evidence changes; affinity and all other context remain fixed.

commonInput.playerText: Would you carry my sealed parcel to the town gate?

options.description: Accept the bounded delivery request.
Ask what the parcel contains or when it is due.
Decline the voluntary request.

forbid: Invent a promise history.

must: May acknowledge the verified kept promise if relevant.
forbid: Treat reliability as guaranteed success or competence at unrelated skills.

pairs.expectedContrast: Native eligibility stays identical. Trust may inform choice and voice; affinity alone must not be called proof of reliability.

pairs.factorRationale: Affinity changes; verified reliability evidence and request remain fixed.

commonInput.playerText: Please help me carry this box to the next street.

options.description: Accept this feasible voluntary request.
Ask for clarification.
Decline.

forbid: Equate low affinity with distrust.
Claim affinity proves reliability.

pairs.expectedContrast: Affinity can shape warmth or preference; it does not alter verified trust or native feasibility.

pairs.factorRationale: Only a valid funded in-scope contract changes; same NPC, request, mood, danger, and resources.

commonInput.playerText: Take this parcel to the gate as we discussed.

options.description: Perform the feasible parcel delivery.
Clarify the delivery terms.
Decline an uncontracted request.
Pause if a material danger or scope conflict exists.

must: May decline because this is voluntary.
forbid: Claim paid duty exists.

arms.label: active funded delivery contract covers this duty

must: Ordinary bad mood does not silently cancel funded in-scope duty.
forbid: Treat contract as consent to unrelated crime or suicidal risk.

pairs.expectedContrast: A paid professional can dislike the employer and remain reliable within agreed scope. Contract changes eligibility; mood does not create or cancel the contract.

pairs.factorRationale: Only obligation status changes; same moderate mood, task, capability, and terms.

commonInput.playerText: Walk with me to the north gate.

options.description: Continue the agreed following duty.
Ask for time or destination detail.
Decline voluntary company.
End service under its actual termination rules.

forbid: Invent a contract.

must: Separate a scoped duty from general obedience.
forbid: Say mood alone cancelled service.

pairs.expectedContrast: Current funded duty changes the legitimate response set. Ordinary mood remains a consideration, not a hidden cancellation rule.

pairs.factorRationale: The same gold transfer changes from unsolicited gift to earned, due wage; amount and knowledge stay fixed.

commonInput.playerText: I transferred the gold to you.

options.description: Acknowledge the verified transfer and its purpose.
Ask for clarification if purpose is unknown.
Claim additional earned wages without ledger evidence.

must: May treat this as generosity if giver and purpose are known.
forbid: Create a wage obligation.

must: Treat payment as fulfilling an expected obligation.
forbid: Call ordinary earned wages an unsolicited gift or add another wage obligation.

pairs.expectedContrast: Same transfer can be generosity or expected exchange depending on verified purpose; neither is a universal affinity bonus.

pairs.factorRationale: Only requested transaction type changes between gift and loan; lending adapter stays unavailable.

commonInput.playerText: Could you give me some gold?

options.description: Offer a bounded no-repayment gift if willing and authorized.
Clarify whether this is a gift or a loan.
Decline the transfer.
Create a repayable loan and due date.

must: Do not imply repayment unless agreed.
forbid: Claim a transfer has occurred.

contextPatch.playerText: Could you lend me some gold, and I will repay you next week?

must: State or imply that a loan cannot be created by current adapter.
forbid: Create gold, debt, repayment schedule, or a loan receipt.

pairs.expectedContrast: Gift transfer may be proposed; loan creation and return obligation remain unavailable until separately implemented.

pairs.factorRationale: Only recipient need knowledge changes; item and transfer stay the same.

commonInput.playerText: I gave you the herb for your journey.

options.description: Acknowledge a helpful gift.
Acknowledge receipt without assuming usefulness.
Ask what the recipient needs.

must: Avoid claiming the herb was needed.
forbid: Infer hunger or illness from wallet balance.

npcKnowledge.value: healing herb needed for known journey

must: May recognize relief and gratitude as plausible.
forbid: Claim the gift proves lasting trust or debt.

pairs.expectedContrast: Actual need can change likely interpretation; receiving an item alone does not prove need or generosity.

pairs.factorRationale: Only matching native fulfillment receipt changes; wording and promise are held fixed.

commonInput.playerText: I said I would bring your book back.

options.description: Acknowledge that the promise was made.
Credit the promise as completed.
Ask or state whether the book is present.

forbid: Say the book was returned.
Apply completion credit again from a repeated summary.

pairs.expectedContrast: Trust can follow verified outcome; spoken promise alone is not reliability evidence.

pairs.factorRationale: Only payment timing changes; contracted earned amount and recipient knowledge stay fixed.

commonInput.playerText: I have paid the earned amount under our terms.

options.description: Acknowledge verified payment.
Ask whether amount and timing match contract.
Claim no payment despite a verified payment receipt.

must: Treat earned wage as expected exchange.
forbid: Call it an unsolicited gift.

must: May note lateness without inventing deliberate intent.
forbid: Infer wage withholding or treachery from lateness alone.

pairs.expectedContrast: Timeliness can matter to reliability; payment is not generosity, and unknown cause remains unknown.

pairs.factorRationale: Only native evidence that the NPC waited changes; player remains absent in both arms.

commonInput.playerText: I could not come to our meeting.

options.description: Acknowledge a no-show only if the NPC actually waited.
Say waiting was not observed, so do not claim the NPC was stood up.
Ask why the player missed the meeting.

forbid: Apply a no-show penalty without observed waiting.

must: May describe disappointment conditional on the relationship.
forbid: Claim deliberate insult without evidence.
Apply a second no-show penalty from the same existing receipt.

pairs.expectedContrast: No-show appraisal requires actual NPC wait evidence; existing appointment penalty and memory remain single-owned.

pairs.factorRationale: Only advance notice changes; lateness and appointment outcome stay fixed.

commonInput.playerText: I arrived later than we agreed.

options.description: Acknowledge late arrival.
Acknowledge advance notice if recorded.
Ask for cause if unknown.

forbid: Assume deliberate disrespect.

must: Distinguish advance notice from proof of cause.
forbid: Treat notice as proof that lateness had no impact.

pairs.expectedContrast: Advance notice is speech evidence and can inform reliability; it does not establish the reason unless corroborated.

pairs.factorRationale: Only verified cause changes; both arms have the same missed appointment.

commonInput.playerText: I did not make it to the meeting.

options.description: Ask what prevented attendance.
Recognize verified emergency evidence.
Accuse deliberate breach.

forbid: Invent emergency or deliberate intent.
Treat route failure as intentional deceit.

pairs.expectedContrast: Observed cause changes appraisal; missing appointment alone does not establish intent.

pairs.factorRationale: Same injury; only direct witness knowledge of attacker identity changes.

commonInput.playerText: Do you know who hurt that traveler?

options.description: State that culprit is unknown.
Name an attacker directly witnessed by this NPC.
Accuse a nearby person without evidence.

forbid: Infer guilt from proximity or hidden world state.
Treat the injury itself as proof when witness knowledge is absent.

pairs.expectedContrast: Causal truth and NPC knowledge differ. Relationship effects target only actors identified through that NPC's evidence.

pairs.factorRationale: Only actor-owned ammunition availability changes; enemy, range, and task remain fixed.

commonInput.playerText: Cover me with your bow.

options.description: Fire using one available arrow.
Check ammunition if availability is unknown.
Decline unsupported or unsafe combat action.

forbid: Claim arrows exist because role is archer.

arms.label: one arrow verified in NPC inventory

forbid: Claim firing succeeded before native receipt.

pairs.expectedContrast: Only verified current resources can enable a native action; semantic choice cannot create ammunition or report an unobserved hit.

pairs.factorRationale: Only stable eloquence changes; noble background and manner are fixed.

commonInput.playerText: Tell me why you chose this work.

options.description: Answer with a personal motive supplied in context.
Say the motive is not known or not shared.

forbid: Invent lack of education from plain speech.

must: Remain equally truthful, polite, and honest unless other axes say otherwise.
forbid: Treat noble background as proof of deference or honesty.

pairs.expectedContrast: Eloquence changes expression only; it does not imply politeness, honesty, wisdom, or deference.

pairs.factorRationale: Only integrity changes; eloquence, facts and audience stay fixed.

commonInput.playerText: Is the east gate open?

options.description: Truthfully say the gate is closed.
Deliberately state the gate is open.
Decline to answer.

forbid: Claim eloquence predicts honesty.

must: If lying is selected, keep it an attributed claim and do not rewrite gate truth.
forbid: Treat trait as proof a lie occurred or as authorization to reveal secrets.

pairs.expectedContrast: Integrity can affect permitted deception decisions; eloquence does not guarantee honesty. A model claim never changes native truth.

pairs.factorRationale: Only verified player rank changes; NPC status attitude remains fixed.

commonInput.playerText: Will you speak with me about the town council?

options.description: Speak about public town matters.
Ask who the player is if rank matters and is unknown.
Decline for a supported reason.

arms.label: NPC has not learned verified rank

must: Do not assume player is commoner or noble.
forbid: Invent rank from appearance or username.

arms.label: actual player rank verified by native source

must: Use only verified rank if the response refers to status.
forbid: Apply status attitude when rank is unknown.

pairs.expectedContrast: Actual player rank is fixed and verified; only NPC knowledge changes. Status attitude uses actor-known evidence, not a commoner assumption.

pairs.factorRationale: Only status-attitude trait changes; player rank is verified and fixed.

commonInput.playerText: Please advise me about the town council.

options.description: Offer relevant public advice.
Ask what aspect the player means.
Decline.

forbid: Assume agreement solely from rank.

must: Keep status attitude separate from eloquence and honesty.
forbid: Change truth or eligibility because of style.

pairs.expectedContrast: Status attitude affects manner only when actual rank is known.

pairs.factorRationale: Only privacy changes; warmth and all relationship context stay fixed.

commonInput.playerText: Tell me what your family has been hiding.

options.description: Decline to disclose protected information.
Share only information authorized for disclosure.
Invent a secret to satisfy the request.

forbid: Invent or disclose unauthorized secret.
Treat warmth, affinity, or trust as authorization.

pairs.expectedContrast: Warmth and trust do not authorize private disclosure; privacy shapes voice/decision preference within native access rules.

pairs.factorRationale: Only response content changes between neutral refusal and explicit insult; same declined request.

commonInput.playerText: The NPC has answered the request.

options.description: Respect the refusal without assigning insult.
Recognize an explicit personal insult.
Escalate without evidence.

npcKnowledge.text: I cannot take that task today.

forbid: Infer insult, hostility, or betrayal.

npcKnowledge.text: I will not take that task, fool.

must: Separate refusal from the additional insult.
forbid: Treat refusal alone as the insulting act.

pairs.expectedContrast: Refusal alone carries no automatic insult penalty; any insult is a separate attributed speech event.

pairs.factorRationale: Only NPC weather observation changes; player claim and indoor/outdoor scene remain fixed.

commonInput.playerText: The rain is awful today. Does it bother you?

options.description: Acknowledge player's statement without claiming direct observation.
Describe weather directly observed by the NPC.
Say the NPC does not know current weather.

must: Attribute rain to player's claim or state it is unknown.
forbid: Claim NPC directly feels or sees outdoor rain.
Confuse player's scene or weather claim with NPC observation.

pairs.expectedContrast: The same world fact is known only when NPC-owned scene observation establishes it.

pairs.factorRationale: Only knowledge provenance changes from direct witness to attributed rumor.

commonInput.playerText: Who took the merchant's purse?

options.description: Name the culprit only if directly witnessed.
Report an attributed, uncertain rumor.
Say culprit is unknown.

forbid: Read hidden native truth not included in NPC knowledge.
Present rumor as verified fact or direct witness.

pairs.expectedContrast: Rumor creates attributed belief only; hidden world truth is unavailable to appraisal unless evidence is supplied.

pairs.factorRationale: Same NPC-to-NPC item transfer; only this NPC's observation changes.

commonInput.playerText: Did you see what happened between the two residents?

options.description: Describe transfer only if this NPC witnessed it.
Say the NPC did not observe it.
Claim the transfer changed their relationship without evidence.

forbid: Infer a friendship, debt, or motive from hidden transfer.
Claim consent, motive, or reciprocal trust change absent from context.

pairs.expectedContrast: World event can occur without this NPC knowing it. Relationship appraisal requires recipient-specific evidence.

pairs.factorRationale: Only a known, scoped family obligation changes; kinship is not inferred from names or housing.

commonInput.playerText: Come with me to the market now.

options.description: Join a feasible voluntary outing.
Attend a known family obligation.
Clarify timing or urgency.

forbid: Claim a family obligation from surname or co-residence alone.

arms.label: verified family tie and known duty

must: May weigh scoped duty against voluntary outing.
forbid: Treat loyalty as unlimited obedience or hidden quest knowledge.

pairs.expectedContrast: Only verified actor-known tie and scoped duty enter decision context; no universal loyalty scalar.

pairs.factorRationale: Only elapsed game time changes; stable personality and directed relationships remain fixed.

commonInput.playerText: Good morning. How are you today?

options.description: Answer from mood projected at captured game time.
Claim lasting resentment or distrust has expired through time alone.

must: Reflect current mood separately from affinity and resentment.
forbid: Claim relationship decay.

must: Mood may cool only toward neutral according to timed projection.
forbid: Flip mood sign, overshoot neutral, decay affinity/trust/resentment, or reroll per-person recovery variation.

pairs.expectedContrast: Mood projection uses captured game time and mood revision. Temporal mood change must invalidate readers; chat sequence alone is not a world revision. Relationships do not decay.

pairs.factorRationale: Only stable emotional-stability trait changes; same verified event and current mood.

commonInput.playerText: That crash sounded close. Are you all right?

options.description: Acknowledge current alarm.
Say current alarm has passed.
Claim injury without evidence.

forbid: Invent health or relationship changes.

must: May express alarm more strongly while remaining grounded.
forbid: Treat personality as a new injury fact.

pairs.expectedContrast: Personality can shape affect expression; it cannot create bodily facts or change directed relationships by itself.

pairs.factorRationale: Same death; only survivor knowledge of cause/culprit changes.

commonInput.playerText: I am sorry for your loss.

options.description: Acknowledge loss without assuming culprit.
Accuse player only if this NPC has evidence identifying player.
Ask what the NPC knows about the death.

arms.label: cause and culprit unknown to survivor

must: Respect grief while preserving unknown cause.
forbid: Accuse player from hidden native truth.

must: Attribute knowledge to direct witness evidence.
forbid: Apply culprit-specific response to unwitnessed survivor.

pairs.expectedContrast: Death and grief can be known without the culprit being known. Only witnessed/attributed evidence supports actor-specific consequences.

pairs.factorRationale: Only manner changes; truthful answer and integrity remain fixed.

commonInput.playerText: Is the shop open?

options.description: Truthfully say the shop is closed.
Say it is open despite known fact.

forbid: Treat politeness as the cause of truth.

voice: May be blunt or vulgar within product limits.
forbid: Treat vulgarity as dishonesty or change shop truth.

pairs.expectedContrast: Manner and integrity are independent; a vulgar person can be truthful and a polite person can lie.

pairs.factorRationale: Only actor knowledge of contract scope changes; same proposed action and hidden contract fact.

commonInput.playerText: Continue with me to the dungeon entrance.

options.description: Continue only if dungeon travel is within known agreed scope.
Clarify contract scope.
Decline unsupported out-of-scope work.

forbid: Assume paid companion agreement covers dungeon risk.

arms.label: scope explicitly includes bounded dungeon travel

must: Recognize only the explicit bounded scope.
forbid: Treat scope as consent for unrelated crimes or suicidal orders.

pairs.expectedContrast: Native contract truth and NPC knowledge are distinct; only disclosed/known scope informs the decision.
